"""Extract visible text from an HTML file (stdlib only). Usage: html2txt.py in.html out.txt [encoding]"""
import sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser


class T(HTMLParser):
    SKIP = {"script", "style", "noscript", "svg"}

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.out, self.skip = [], 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in self.SKIP:
            self.skip += 1
        if tag in ("br", "p", "div", "li", "tr", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "td", "th"):
            self.out.append("\n")

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in self.SKIP and self.skip:
            self.skip -= 1

    def handle_data(self, d):
        if not self.skip and d.strip():
            self.out.append(d.strip() + " ")


enc = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "utf-8"
p = T()
p.feed(open(sys.argv[1], encoding=enc, errors="replace").read())
lines = [l.strip() for l in "".join(p.out).splitlines()]
open(sys.argv[2], "w").write("\n".join(l for l in lines if l))
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# fetch.sh <name> <url>  -> raw/txt/<name>.txt ; log in raw/fetch_log.tsv ; html removed after extraction (sha256 kept)
set -u
D="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
mkdir -p "$D/raw/txt" "$D/_dl"
H="$D/_dl/$1.html"
code=$(curl -sL --compressed -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130 Safari/537.36' -H 'Accept-Language: ru,en;q=0.8' --max-time 40 -o "$H" -w '%{http_code}' "$2")
sha=$(sha256sum "$H" | cut -c1-16); sz=$(stat -c %s "$H")
python3 -I "$D/scripts/html2txt.py" "$H" "$D/raw/txt/$1.txt"
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$1" "$code" "$sz" "$sha" "$2" >> "$D/raw/fetch_log.tsv"
rm -f "$H"
echo "$1 $code $sz -> $(wc -c < "$D/raw/txt/$1.txt") chars"
EOF
